blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Quarterfinal-bound Gilas Pilipinas fell to fancied host Japan, 89-67, on Tuesday to place second in Group B of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 women’s 5-on-5 basketball competition. Gilas hardly had a response to Japan’s early onslaught before winding up absorbing its first defeat after opening the campaign with victories over Kazakhstan and Hong Kong. Miyu Okamoto scored 19 points while Ami Tsuneta added 18 as Japan topped the group with a perfect 3-0 win-loss slate.
